prompt: Add `Checkout.Pay(cart, code, country, cardToken)` in Shop/Checkout.cs. It applies the coupon `code` from the coupon book, which must refuse an expired coupon with `CouponExpiredException`; adds VAT for the customer's country (20% for "GB", 19% for "DE", 21% for "NL", none elsewhere; more countries will follow); charges the result through `StripeClient.CreateCharge` in Shop/StripeClient.cs; and returns the charge id. We may add PayPal at some point. `App.BuildCheckout(client)` in Shop/App.cs must return a ready checkout that charges through `client`.
